scope: Independent proposed-circuit review only. No final CAD approval; owner working. No live/current CAD read or mutation.

preserve.VALVE1: R55.2 -> Q10 gate through R55; Q10 drives U10
preserve.VALVE2: R36.2 -> Q8 gate through R36; Q8 drives U9

button_power.pullup_supply: HOST_3V3 from master Qwiic J9; no LOCAL3V3 connection permitted
button_power.host_off_board_on: No local3V3 source to buttons; external GPIO controller must be same master powering HOST_3V3.
button_power.host_on_board_off: Passive button circuit stays host powered; gates only reached through local PCA, not button nets.
button_power.cable_condition: J19 requires GND and four GPIO inputs; J9 supplies HOST_3V3. Each board requires four distinct GPIO wires; do not parallel J19 signals across boards.
button_power.ESD: External header is a short internal wiring connection; no system-level exposed-port ESD or long-cable immunity qualified.

PCA_policy.startup: POR outputs LOW, FULL_OFF defaults set. SLEEP defaults1; clear SLEEP, wait at least500us for oscillator before active output writes. Initialize all loads off.
PCA_policy.last_state: OE held low by existingR23=10k. No communication-timeout circuit. Normal last register states remain while local power and clock continue.
PCA_policy.coupling: Global reset, SLEEP, OE, ALL_LED and prescaler setup affect pumps and valves. Set frequency at startup with loads off; do not periodically reset/reinitialize active controller. FULL_ON/FULL_OFF avoids periodic valve PWM but not shared-controller dependencies.
PCA_policy.caveat: 4095 is nearly100% PWM, not static FULL_ON. FULL_OFF wins if both flags set.

capacitance_reconciliation.note: Onboard direct shunt capacitance only; sensor-module capacitance remains unspecified.

verdict: Proposed change electrically supported, conditional on final saved connectivity/layout checks and firmware configuration. No new design blocker identified.
